# One Forward, Many Phones

<!-- STEP id="one-forward" -->
## One Message in the Morning

At 7 in the morning a phone buzzes. A message says that voting has moved to a later date. It looks like news, but it is false.

Press Forward and see how far it goes by night.

<!-- STEP id="readers-are-voters" -->
## Most Readers Are Voters

Most of these phones belong to voters: farmers, shopkeepers, students and first-time voters.

**What happens to a democracy when people choose while believing something false?**
